notes.title: MacOS Patch for 1.6.1
notes.content: This brings a previous bug fix to Mac.

notes.title: Rush mode bug fix for Windows
notes.content: This patch fixes a rare bug when you get a ridiculously long combo at the very end of rush mode. This update is currently for Windows only because Apple is gaslighting me.

notes.title: Two new soundpacks: Hazard and Core Fault
notes.content:
We're happy to bring two new soundpacks to Mixolumia! The first is a Rush Mode track called Hazard. The second is a Marathon/Endless mode tie-in to Dave's recent Playdate release, Core Fault.

This update also adds a few new color palettes.

notes.title: New Soundpack, Color Editor, and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711736/37c9fa4ee901316e01bc23f6b6fb6ba945717e5c.png[/img]
We're proud to bring this huge new update to Mixolumia, which includes:
[list]
[*] Cool new visual effects
[*] A zoom option to make the board bigger on small screens (looking at you, Steam Deck)
[*] A ridiculously zoomed tate mode for gaming on screens in the portrait orientation
[*] A tutorial and light scaffolding for new players
[*] A color editor for creating and managing color palettes in-game
[*] A new soundpack, Quasar
[/list]
You'll notice we've spruced up the branding a bit and added a new trailer, too. Look forward to some more game updates down the road!

notes.title: Update 1.3.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Consolidated menus, made profile selection less prominent
[*] New players start with a default profile
[*] Players can now edit profile names
[*] Hopefully addressed text positioning issue
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Support for aspect ratios beyond 16:9 and pixel-perfect scaling
[*] Preview color palettes before switching so flipping past light palettes doesn't burn your eyes out
[*] Preload soundpacks for better performance
[*] In-game discord link
[*] Settings in endgame menu
[*] Option to pick a new track when game ends
[*] Show currently falling blocks at the end of impossible mode
[/list]

notes.title: Mixolumia Receives Honorable Mention for Excellence in Audio From IGF
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711736/f97d2c1e25f0871586f24adc18bdb4220a05b7bf.png[/img]

We're thrilled find out Mixolumia has [url=https://igf.com/article/genesis-noir-leads-igf-finalists-four-nominations]received an honorable mention[/url] in the category of Excellence in Audio from the Independent Games Festival this week. Standing out among the 500+ other games in the running seemed like an impossible feat, so we're overjoyed our weird little puzzle game was noticed among all that incredible talent.

Much love to Josie and Jasmine, and thanks to everyone who has supported the game along the way!

notes.title: Mac version + New Music
notes.content:
Mixolumia version 1.2.6 is live! This brings some bug fixes and (finally) a Mac version on Steam! Oh yeah, and there's one more thing...

We are super excited to bring composer Jasmine Cooper on board the Mixolumia team! Josie and I are big fans of Jasmine's work and wanted to bring her unique voice into the game, and I couldn't be happier to present her haunting, funky, gorgeous track, Dissolve, free in this update. ✨🔷🎶

notes.title: Update 1.2.5s
notes.content: There have been some infrequent but random crashes that I believe was caused by instability in the latest engine update, so I've rolled back to a previous runtime to hopefully alleviate the issue.
